situation: I've been fighting a flaky Cypress test for two hours and Jonas wrote most of that test suite. We're peers, he's busy with the release too. How do I ask him without sounding helpless?
reply: Hey Jonas, the checkout Cypress test is failing about one run in three and I've spent two hours on it. I've ruled out the test data and the retry config, and it only fails in CI, not locally. Could you pair with me for 15 minutes this afternoon? If you're buried in the release, tomorrow morning works too.
note: Showing the two things already ruled out turns 'help me' into 'help me finish', and 15 minutes is easy to say yes to.

situation: 我是组长，想把下个月客户年会的物料统筹交给新来的同事小周，她之前在上一家公司做过活动。怎么说才不像甩锅？
reply: 小周，想请你来负责11月18号客户年会的全部物料统筹。你之前做过好几场活动，这块你比组里其他人都熟。完成的标准是：11月8号前把展架、手册和伴手礼都定稿下单，预算控制在3万以内。初稿出来我随时帮你过一遍，我也会跟王经理说好，这件事正式算在你的工作量里。你看现在手上的事情，接得下来吗？
note: 说清结果、为什么是她、完成标准和截止日，最后真心问一句她接不接得住，而不是直接派活。

situation: In a meeting with the VP today she asked me what our churn rate was for enterprise accounts last quarter and I blanked. I want to send a follow-up on Slack.
reply: Hi Carla, on your question about enterprise churn in Q2: I didn't have the number in my head and didn't want to guess. I'm pulling it from the billing data with Ahmed now and will send you the exact figure, with the three biggest accounts we lost, by 4pm today. Is this for the board deck, or something else I should shape it for?
note: The 'I don't know' formula: say it cleanly, name the next step and a time, and ask what the answer feeds into.

situation: I'm a marketing manager and need someone from legal to review the rules for our October giveaway before it goes live on Monday Oct 12. Nobody in legal reports to me and I've never worked with them. The legal ops contact is Grace Liu.
reply: Hi Grace, I'm running the Harvest giveaway for marketing, launching Monday 12 October, and we need a legal review of the official rules before it goes live. It's a two-page doc, and I've highlighted the three sections I'm least sure about: eligibility, prize value and the entry deadline. Could someone on your team review it by end of day Wednesday 7 October? If that's too tight with your current queue, tell me what date works and I'll plan the launch around it.
note: Cross-team you have no authority, so make the job small, say exactly what done looks like, and let them name the date if yours doesn't fit.

situation: I asked my peer Ravi on the data team to build the churn dashboard for our QBR by Friday Oct 9. He replied that there's no way, he's on the migration until the 16th. I still need something for the QBR on Monday Oct 12.
reply: Understood, Ravi, the migration comes first. Could we trim it to just the monthly churn chart by plan tier, from the existing billing table? If that's doable by Friday 9 October, I'll handle the formatting and the rest of the deck. If even that doesn't fit, is there someone else on your team who knows that table?
note: When a delegated task gets a no, negotiate scope or ask who else, instead of repeating the original ask. If it's still no, flag it to your manager today.

situation: 我手上同时有三个项目：官网改版、双十一活动页、还有领导上周又加给我的供应商系统对接，都说要10月底前完成，我一个人肯定做不完。想让李总定优先级，但不想显得在推活。
reply: 李总，想跟您对一下我手上三个项目的优先级。官网改版、双十一活动页、供应商系统对接目前都排在10月30号前，按我估的工作量，一个人能保证两个按时高质量交付。我的建议是：活动页优先，因为11月1号要开始预热；官网按原计划；供应商对接推到11月中，或者请技术部小王先接前期的接口梳理。您看哪个方案合适？今天能定的话，我明天一早就按新排期推进。
note: 向上求助要带上工作量判断和一个推荐方案，让领导做选择题，而不是把问题整个丢过去。

situation: I'm the new team lead and about 20 years older than most of my team. My report Maya is the Figma expert and I need to be able to edit our prototypes before the Harlow client review on Thursday Oct 8. Asking someone junior to teach me feels strange.
reply: Hi Maya, could you teach me something? I need to make small edits to the onboarding prototype before the Harlow review on Thursday Oct 8, and you know Figma far better than I do. I've done the basics tutorial, so it's mainly components and how the flows link up that I'm stuck on. Could you spare 30 minutes before then, maybe Friday or Monday? If you're heads-down, a pointer to a good walkthrough would help too.
note: Asking down uses the same shape as asking across: what you've tried, the exact gap, the time cost and an out. Saying she knows it better is context, not flattery.

situation: Yesterday I posted in our #data-help Slack channel asking why the Salesforce sync drops leads created on weekends. Nobody replied. Tomás built the original sync but moved to the payments team in June.
reply: Hi Tomás, quick one about the Salesforce sync you built. It's dropping leads created on weekends, 43 of them last Saturday and Sunday. I've checked the field mappings and the API limits and both look fine, so I suspect the scheduler. Could you look at it with me for 15 minutes on Thursday or Friday? If payments has you swamped, a pointer to where the scheduler config lives would already help a lot.
note: When a group post gets silence, don't re-post: ask one named person directly, with what you've ruled out and a small, time-boxed ask.

situation: 我10月12号到16号请了年假。手上跟华东几家供应商的对账邮件每天都有，想请同组的小林帮我盯一下。我们是平级，她手上的活也不轻。
reply: 小林，想请你帮个忙：我10月12日到16日休年假，这周华东供应商的对账邮件能不能帮我盯一下？每天大概三四封，基本是确认金额。模板和对账表我9日周五前整理好放在共享盘，遇到金额对不上的直接放着，等我19日回来处理。之后你休假或者忙不过来的时候，你那边的周报我来接。看你那周手上的事，接得过来吗？不方便也没关系，我再找别人。
note: 平级之间没有分派的权力：说清范围和工作量，把难的留给自己，给一个交换，也给退路。

situation: I'm an account manager at a payroll software company. On a call today, a client, Deborah at Fernway Clinics, asked whether our system will handle Colorado's new overtime rules starting in January. I didn't know and said I'd check. Sending a follow-up email.
reply: Hi Deborah, on your question about the Colorado overtime changes you mentioned for January: I don't know off the top of my head whether our system covers them, and I'd rather check than guess on something that affects your payroll. I've asked our compliance lead, Marcus Webb, and I'll come back to you with a clear answer by Thursday 1 October. Which pay run do you need it confirmed for? That will help us check the right thing.
note: "I don't know" works with clients too: say it cleanly, name who you're asking and when they'll hear back.

situation: I'm three weeks into managing a team of 5. In our team Slack, Omar asked whether unused holiday days roll over into next year. I have no idea and I don't want to guess.
reply: Good question, Omar, and I don't know yet. I'd rather check than guess on something that affects your leave. I've asked Priya in HR and I'll post the answer here by Thursday, so everyone sees the same thing.
note: A new manager earns credibility with a fast 'I don't know' plus a named source and a date; answering in the same thread keeps it fair for everyone.

situation: 上周我们组的报表系统出故障，隔壁数据组的阿杰连着加了两个晚上班帮我们修好，赶上了周一给客户的月报。这不是他的活。想在部门群里谢谢他，也让他领导孙姐看到。
reply: @阿杰 正式谢谢你！上周报表系统出故障，你连着两个晚上帮我们排查，定位到是数据同步任务的时区设置，周一给恒达的月报才按时发出去。这本来不是你的活，你还顺手写了一份排查文档，以后我们组自己就能处理。@孙姐 想让您也知道，这次阿杰真的帮了大忙。下次你们组需要人手，随时叫我们。
note: 感谢要具体到他做了什么、带来了什么结果，并且发在他领导看得到的地方。

situation: I'm new to our Python codebase and I've already asked my teammate Anika for help twice this month. I'm stuck again on the deploy script and I feel like I'm becoming a burden.
reply: Hi Anika, I know I've leaned on you a couple of times this month, so I've done my homework first: the deploy script fails at the migration step, and I've checked the env vars and rerun it from a clean branch with the same error. Could you spare 15 minutes this afternoon or tomorrow morning? I'll write up whatever we find in the team wiki so the next new person doesn't need to ask you, and if you want to hand me the release notes this sprint, I'm glad to take them.
note: Name the pattern once and give something back; a third apology would make it heavier, not lighter.

situation: I manage a team of 6. Every quarter someone has to do the access review audit, about six hours of checking spreadsheets. Tom did it last quarter; I want to hand it to Lena without pretending it's a growth opportunity.
reply: Hi Lena, I'd like you to take the Q4 access review this time. To be straight with you, it's about six hours of checking spreadsheets, not a stretch project, and we rotate it so it never lands on the same person twice. Done means every account signed off in the tracker by Friday 23 October, and Tom will give you 15 minutes on his notes from last quarter. I'll take something else off your plate to make room, so tell me which ticket can slip a week. Does that work with what you've got on?
note: For dull work, 'it's your turn in the rotation' is an honest why-them; dressing it up as growth backfires.

situation: Two weeks ago I delegated the vendor cost review to Kenji on my team, due Friday Oct 9 for the budget meeting on Monday Oct 12. I haven't heard a word since. I don't want to micromanage, but I need to know it's on track.
reply: Hi Kenji, quick check-in on the vendor cost review, not a status meeting. Is Friday 9 October still realistic for you? If anything's stuck, like missing contracts or a vendor not replying, tell me now and I'll chase it; if we need to, it could cover just our top ten vendors for Monday's budget meeting. A one-line reply is plenty.
note: Check the outcome and the date, not the steps, and offer to remove blockers or trim scope; that is support, not micromanagement.

situation: I'm a nurse on a surgical ward. My son's school play is Saturday Oct 10 and I'm rostered on the day shift. My colleague Tasha is on days Sunday Oct 11 and I'm off that day. Swaps need sign-off from our charge nurse, Grace.
reply: Hi Tasha, could I ask you a favour? My son's school play is on Saturday 10 October and I'm on the day shift. Would you swap your Sunday 11 October day for my Saturday? Same hours, and I'll put the request to Grace myself so it's official. If Saturday doesn't suit you, no problem at all, just say and I'll ask around.
note: A shift swap is a peer ask with no authority: name the exact trade, take on the admin yourself, and give a real out.

situation: I'm in Singapore and present the Q3 forecast to our regional CFO on Friday Oct 2 at 9am my time. The LatAm tab shows a 14% margin and I can't tell whether freight is in cost of goods. The analyst who built it, Beatriz, is in São Paulo, 11 hours behind, and we've never worked together.
reply: Hi Beatriz, I'm Wei from the Singapore finance team. I'm presenting the Q3 forecast to our regional CFO on Friday 2 October at 9am Singapore time, which is Thursday 8pm for you. I can follow the LatAm revenue, but I can't tell whether freight is included in cost of goods for the 14% margin. Could you reply in writing by the end of your Wednesday? Three or four lines is plenty, and if that's too tight, just say so and I'll present the margin as provisional.
note: Across time zones, write the ask so it can be answered without a call: the exact question, both local times, and an out.

situation: 我是运营组长。上个月让下属小何做9月的用户数据周报，他晚交了两天，原因是到最后才发现数据口径不对。这个月的季度复盘材料我还想交给他做，10月16号周五要交给总监，但不想让他觉得我不信任他。
reply: 小何，这次的季度复盘材料还想请你来做，10月16号周五要交给总监。上次周报卡在最后才发现数据口径不对，这次我们把检查点往前挪：10月9号周五你先给我看口径和提纲，我当天回你意见，后面你放手做。中间哪里卡住了随时找我，不用等到检查点。这个节奏你觉得可以吗？
note: 再交给出过问题的人：直说上次卡在哪一步，用提前的检查点代替盯人，信任和兜底一起给。

situation: I coordinate volunteers at our neighbourhood food bank. I'm stepping back from running the Saturday intake rota from November and want Mercy, who has volunteered on intake every Saturday for two years, to take it over. It's about an hour a week in a shared spreadsheet, filling four slots and finding cover, and she's unpaid like everyone; I'd do the October rotas with her first.
reply: Hi Mercy, could I ask you something bigger than usual? From November I'm stepping back from the Saturday intake rota, and I'd love you to take over running it. You've been on intake every Saturday for two years, so you know how it really works. It's about an hour a week in the shared spreadsheet: filling the four slots and finding cover when someone drops out. I'll do the October rotas with you so you've run it once with me before it's yours. It's a volunteer role, so a no is completely fine; would you be up for it?
note: With volunteers you have no authority at all: be exact about the time cost and make the no genuinely easy.

situation: 我是产品经理，10月16日（周五）要上线一个活动页，我们组唯一的设计师在休产假。隔壁增长组的设计师小美做过类似的页面，我想借她10月8日、9日两天出视觉稿，文案和原型我都准备好了。她归增长组的周姐管，我想先问周姐，再去跟小美说。
reply: 周姐，想跟您借个人：我们10月16日（周五）要上线一个活动页，组里唯一的设计师在休产假，小美之前做过类似的页面，是最合适的人选。想借她10月8日、9日两天，文案和原型我都已经准备好，她只需要出视觉稿。您看她那两天排得开吗？时间不合适的话，告诉我哪两天方便，我这边调整；您同意了我再去跟小美对具体安排。
note: 借别组的人先问她的领导：说清为什么是她、借多久、已经做到哪一步，再把改时间的余地留给对方。

situation: For my cost report due Friday Oct 9 I need last quarter's travel spend by department, just the raw export, and Karen in finance is the only one with access. In last month's budget meeting I pushed back hard on her numbers in front of everyone, and it's been frosty since. I do think I owe her an apology for how I did it.
reply: Hi Karen, first, I came in too hard on your numbers in last month's budget meeting, and doing it in front of everyone wasn't fair to you. I'm sorry. Separately, could I ask for your help? I need last quarter's travel spend by department for my cost report due Friday 9 October, and you're the only one with access. Just the raw export is plenty, no analysis. If this week is too tight, tell me what works and I'll plan around it.
note: Apologise for the meeting on its own terms, then ask; if the apology feels like a price for the favour, send it a day earlier.

situation: I'm handling the escalation from Corlane Foods about their failed September delivery run. I've had two calls with their ops lead and offered a re-delivery plan, but their COO, Martin Hale, now wants someone senior on a 30-minute call tomorrow, Thursday, at 2pm. My manager Rachel usually leaves client calls to me and her calendar is packed.
reply: Hi Rachel, could I borrow 30 minutes of your time tomorrow? I've had two calls with Corlane's ops lead about the failed September delivery run and offered them a re-delivery plan, but their COO, Martin Hale, wants someone senior on a call at 2pm Thursday. I'll lead the call and send you a one-page brief by 9am, so it's mainly about you being there. If 2pm doesn't work, could you give me a time I can offer him instead?
note: Asking upward follows the same shape as asking a peer: what you've done, the exact ask, the time cost, and an easy alternative.

situation: I'm leaving the company and my last day is Friday Oct 16. Our manager Hannah agreed my peer Dmitri should take over my three client accounts, Brookfield Dental, Orla Studio and Kessler Farms; he already knows Brookfield from covering my holidays. I'll write a handover doc for each by Friday Oct 9 and can do intro calls with him and each client the week of Oct 12.
reply: Hi Dmitri, my last day is Friday 16 October, and Hannah and I would like you to take over Brookfield Dental, Orla Studio and Kessler Farms. You already know Brookfield from covering my holidays, so you're the natural fit. Done means each client knows you're their contact and you can run the account without me. I'll send a handover doc for each by Friday 9 October, and the week of 12 October I'll set up intro calls with you and each client while I'm still around. Can you take them on alongside what you've got?
note: A leaving handover is still delegation: the outcome, why them, your part with dates, then a real question rather than an announcement.

situation: I'm a solutions engineer on a live demo call with a prospect, Helmsworth Insurance. Their IT lead, Femi, just asked whether our audit logs can be exported to their own storage automatically. I'm not sure, and our product lead, Ana, is the one who'd know. What do I say out loud right now?
reply: Good question, Femi, and I don't know for certain whether that export can run automatically. I'd rather not guess on something your security team will rely on. I'll check with Ana, our product lead, and email you a clear answer by end of day tomorrow. Is this for a compliance requirement? That'll help me make sure we answer the right question.
note: Live and on the spot, the same formula works spoken: say it cleanly, name who you'll ask and when, then move the demo on.

situation: 我上个月刚升组长，组里的老刘比我早来八年，做过很多次验厂。想把新供应商华晟的验厂交给他，10月23日（周五）前出报告，结论是能不能进合格供应商名单、有哪些整改项。怕他觉得我在指挥他。
reply: 刘哥，想请你负责新供应商华晟的验厂。这块你比组里谁都有经验，交给你最合适。要的结果是10月23日（周五）前出一份报告：能不能进合格供应商名单，有哪些整改项。具体怎么查你来定，需要跟采购那边协调的话告诉我，我去沟通。你手上现在的活排得开吗？
note: 交给比自己资深的人，只说要什么结果和截止日，不列步骤，最后真心问一句他排不排得开。

situation: My dad has just been taken to hospital after a fall and I'm leaving work now. At 2pm I'm meant to run a 90-minute onboarding workshop for our new client Harrow Foods; my teammate Sam co-wrote the slides with me and has run the same workshop for two other clients. Our manager Priti is on leave today.
reply: Sam, family emergency: my dad's been taken to hospital after a fall and I'm leaving now. Could you run the 2pm Harrow Foods onboarding workshop? It's the deck we wrote together, and you've run it twice already, so you'd be great. If you can, I'll email Harrow's contact to say you're leading it. If you can't, tell me in the next 20 minutes and I'll ask them to move it to next week, no problem at all. I'll leave Priti a note so she knows when she's back.
note: Even in an emergency, delegating is an ask: the outcome, why them, and a real out with a fallback, in as few lines as possible.

situation: Trabajo en producto. Le pedí a Lucía, de atención al cliente, que revisara las 30 incidencias abiertas de clientes premium antes de mi informe del jueves 8 de octubre, y me contestó: «Eso no le toca a soporte, es cosa de producto». En realidad solo necesito saber cuáles siguen sin respuesta, y ese dato está en su herramienta de tickets, a la que yo no tengo acceso.
reply: Tienes razón, Lucía, el análisis es cosa nuestra y lo hago yo. Lo único que necesito de vuestro lado es saber cuáles de esas 30 incidencias siguen sin respuesta, porque ese dato solo está en vuestra herramienta de tickets. ¿Podrías pasarme una exportación con el número de incidencia y su estado antes del miércoles 7 de octubre? Si no te da tiempo, dime quién de tu equipo podría hacerlo o si es posible que me deis acceso de lectura y lo saco yo.
note: Ante un «no me toca», reconoce la parte en la que tiene razón, reduce el pedido a lo que solo ellos pueden dar y ofrece una alternativa.
